title: BRICS Tracker Update — Sat May 9, 2026
summary: India's 2026 BRICS chairmanship advanced this week with two working group milestones. The Second BRICS Employment Working Group Meeting concluded on May 7 in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, setting labor cooperation priorities including social security, women's workforce participation, and green-economy skills development. On May 8, India hosted the First BRICS MSME Working Group Meeting virtually, focused on bridging the SME credit gap through financial inclusion and fintech-driven payment ecosystems. The claims section was updated to reflect BRICS Bridge processing $55.49B across 4,000+ transactions and BRICS Pay targeting a September 2026 launch. Maps and economic data updated ahead of the BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New Delhi on May 14–15.
